hint: Percent means "out of $100$". Think about which simple fraction is the same as $25$ out of $100$.
explanation: Percent means "per hundred", so $25\%$ is $\frac{25}{100}$, which simplifies to $\frac{1}{4}$.
Taking one fourth of a number means dividing it by $4$, so compute $80 \div 4 = 20$.
Check the result with decimals: $0.25 \times 80 = 20$, which matches the first method.
The final answer is that $25\%$ of $80$ equals $20$.

alternativeExplanations.title: 10% trick
steps: $10\%$ of $80$ is $8$ (move the decimal one place).

hints.text: Percent means "out of $100$". Think about which simple fraction is the same as $25$ out of $100$.
$25\%$ equals $\frac{1}{4}$, so finding $25\%$ of $80$ is the same as splitting $80$ into $4$ equal parts: work out $80 \div 4$.
Dividing gives $80 \div 4 = 20$, so the answer is that $25\%$ of $80$ equals $20$.
